001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Control-IQ's rolling two-hour total of the insulin it commanded itself, written every 15 minutes
009 * (a 900-second timer from pump start-up, in the same second of the minute as
010 * {@link DailyBasalHistoryLog}). The three floats are sums in units over the last 24 five-minute
011 * Control-IQ cycles: for every cycle in which the algorithm was in control ({@link
012 * BasalDeliveryHistoryLog} source ALGORITHM or TEMP_RATE_AND_ALGORITHM), the commanded basal rate
013 * times 5 minutes, plus each automatic correction bolus. User-initiated boluses are not counted.
014 * Rebuilt from the 227 cycle times, BasalDelivery (279) rates and automatic BolusDelivery (280)
015 * records, all three fields matched within 0.005 U in 84-100% of 1,241 records from four pumps
016 * (t:slim X2 and Mobi); the misses are one five-minute slot off, for exactly two hours.
017 *
018 * <p>All three are exactly 0 until Control-IQ has run in closed loop since the pump last started
019 * ({@link ArmInitHistoryLog}). When closed loop stops, old cycles still expire, so the sums fall to
020 * float rounding residue (magnitude below 2e-5 U), not to exactly 0.
021 *
022 * <p>These are pump-internal Control-IQ values: do not use them for dosing or IOB.
023 *
024 * <p>The class name is provisional: opcode 237 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
025 * app's history log list. {@link #getUnknown22()} is exposed raw. See
026 * https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/146.
027 */
028@HistoryLogProps(
029    opCode = 237,
030    displayName = "Control-IQ Automated Insulin"
031)
032public class ControlIQAutomatedInsulinHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
033    /** Larger than the float residue the sums settle at, smaller than one 5-minute basal slot. */
034    public static final float RESIDUE_THRESHOLD_UNITS = 0.001f;
035
036    private float totalInsulin;
037    private float basalAboveProfileInsulin;
038    private float autoBolusInsulin;
039    private long unknown22;
040
041    public ControlIQAutomatedInsulinHistoryLog() {}
042    public ControlIQAutomatedInsulinHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, float totalInsulin, float basalAboveProfileInsulin, float autoBolusInsulin, long unknown22) {
043        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
044        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, totalInsulin, basalAboveProfileInsulin, autoBolusInsulin, unknown22);
045        this.totalInsulin = totalInsulin;
046        this.basalAboveProfileInsulin = basalAboveProfileInsulin;
047        this.autoBolusInsulin = autoBolusInsulin;
048        this.unknown22 = unknown22;
049    }
050
051    public int typeId() {
052        return 237;
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * <table border="1">
057     * <caption>Parsed fields for ControlIQAutomatedInsulinHistoryLog:</caption>
058     * <tr><td><code>totalInsulin</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>basalAboveProfileInsulin</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>autoBolusInsulin</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>unknown22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
062     * </table>
063     */
064    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
065        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
066        this.cargo = raw;
067        parseBase(raw);
068        this.totalInsulin = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 10);
069        this.basalAboveProfileInsulin = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14);
070        this.autoBolusInsulin = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
071        this.unknown22 = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
072    }
073
074    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, float totalInsulin, float basalAboveProfileInsulin, float autoBolusInsulin, long unknown22) {
075        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
076            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(237, 0),
077            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
078            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
079            Bytes.toFloat(totalInsulin),
080            Bytes.toFloat(basalAboveProfileInsulin),
081            Bytes.toFloat(autoBolusInsulin),
082            Bytes.toUint32(unknown22)));
083    }
084
085    /**
086     * Basal Control-IQ commanded over the last two hours plus its automatic correction boluses.
087     * Always at least {@link #getBasalAboveProfileInsulin()} + {@link #getAutoBolusInsulin()}.
088     *
089     * @return insulin in units (float32 at offset 10)
090     */
091    public float getTotalInsulin() {
092        return totalInsulin;
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * For each cycle in the window, max(0, commanded rate - profile rate) times 5 minutes: the
097     * insulin Control-IQ added by raising basal above the profile.
098     *
099     * @return insulin in units (float32 at offset 14)
100     */
101    public float getBasalAboveProfileInsulin() {
102        return basalAboveProfileInsulin;
103    }
104
105    /**
106     * Automatic correction boluses in the window, counted at the Control-IQ cycle that decided them
107     * (47-141 s before the BolusDelivery STARTED record) and dropped two hours later. Matched
108     * the requested amount of all 20 automatic boluses seen, to 0.001 U. Three times it also held
109     * an amount with no automatic bolus record; each time the Control-IQ cycle fell during a user
110     * bolus.
111     *
112     * @return insulin in units (float32 at offset 18)
113     */
114    public float getAutoBolusInsulin() {
115        return autoBolusInsulin;
116    }
117
118    /**
119     * @return {@link #getTotalInsulin()} minus {@link #getAutoBolusInsulin()}: the basal Control-IQ
120     * commanded over the last two hours, in units
121     */
122    public float getBasalInsulin() {
123        return totalInsulin - autoBolusInsulin;
124    }
125
126    /**
127     * @return false when every sum is 0 or float residue, i.e. Control-IQ commanded no insulin in
128     * the last two hours (or has not run in closed loop since the pump started)
129     */
130    public boolean hasAutomatedInsulin() {
131        return Math.abs(totalInsulin) >= RESIDUE_THRESHOLD_UNITS
132            || Math.abs(basalAboveProfileInsulin) >= RESIDUE_THRESHOLD_UNITS
133            || Math.abs(autoBolusInsulin) >= RESIDUE_THRESHOLD_UNITS;
134    }
135
136    /**
137     * 0 in all 4,668 records seen.
138     *
139     * @return raw uint32 at offset 22
140     */
141    public long getUnknown22() {
142        return unknown22;
143    }
144}
